$comment: The site's footage. Each entry is generated once by scripts/assets.mjs and committed to public/reel/.
HONESTY RULE: `source` decides the label the site shows. Nothing here was made by the KunoWorld
network — these are reference renders from the same open weights our miners run, generated on fal.
When we have GPUs, regenerate through our own gateway and set source to 'kuno' so the clips carry a
real certificate. Never label a fal render as network output.
endpoint: a fal model id. fast = $0.04/s @1080p, pro = $0.06/s. duration is in seconds (6..20).
Keep hero clips on pro and everything else on fast; see the budget line printed by the script.
